questions.question: For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, what is the discriminant (D)?
questions.question_bn: ax² + bx + c = 0 সমীকরণের নিরূপক (Discriminant) কোনটি?
questions.explanation: The discriminant D = b² - 4ac determines the nature of the roots.

questions.question: If the discriminant D > 0, what are the nature of the roots?
questions.question_bn: যদি D > 0 হয়, তবে সমীকরণের বীজদ্বয় কেমন হবে?
questions.explanation: When D > 0, the equation has two distinct real roots.

questions.question: What is the sum of the roots (α + β) of the quadratic equation 2x² - 8x + 6 = 0?
What is the product of roots (α · β) of the equation 3x² + 5x - 12 = 0?
questions.explanation: Product of roots α · β = c/a = -12/3 = -4.
